import json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from tqdm import tqdm
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load training data
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)

# Load test data
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

# Convert to DataFrame
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

# Extract target
train_df["target"] = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)


# Prepare features from text fields
def prepare_features(df):
    # Feature engineering - combine request_title, request_text_edit_aware
    df["text_combined"] = (
        df["request_title"].fillna("") + " " + df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
    )

    # Text preprocessing - remove punctuation, convert to lowercase
    df["text_cleaned"] = df["text_combined"].apply(
        lambda x: str(x).lower().replace("[^a-z0-9]", "").strip()
    )

    # Tokenize
    token_lists = []
    for txt in df["text_cleaned"]:
        tokens = [
            word for word in txt.split() if len(word) > 2
        ]  # Remove single letter words
        token_lists.append(len(tokens))
    df["token_count"] = token_lists

    # Word frequency - simple n-grams count
    def word_freq(text):
        return len([w for w in text.lower().split() if w])

    df["word_freq"] = df["text_cleaned"].apply(word_freq)

    # Emotional tone indicators (positive keywords)
    positive_words = [
        "thank",
        "great",
        "helpful",
        "please",
        "yes",
        "love",
        "kind",
        "nice",
        "free",
        "thanks",
        "amazing",
    ]
    negative_words = ["edit", "removed", "closed", "failed", "unsuccessful", "sorry"]

    def score_tone(text):
        txt_lower = text.lower()
        pos = sum(1 for w in positive_words if w in txt_lower)
        neg = sum(1 for w in negative_words if w in txt_lower)
        return pos - neg

    df["tone_score"] = df["text_cleaned"].apply(score_tone)

    return df


# Apply feature preparation
train_df = prepare_features(train_df.copy())
test_df = prepare_features(test_df.copy())

# Select features for model
feature_cols = [
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
    "giver_username_if_known",  # Will map to binary indicator
    "text_cleaned",
    "token_count",
    "word_freq",
    "tone_score",
]

test_df["is_giver_known"] = (~test_df["giver_username_if_known"].isna()).astype(int)

y_train = train_df["target"].values

    X_val[col] = X_val[col].fillna(-999)

X_train = X_train.dropna(axis=1)

            X_train_scaled.iloc[idx].values[j]
            if j < 2
            else X_train.loc[idx, feature_cols[j]]
        )
    idx += 1

X_train_processed = np.column_stack(
    [
        scaler.transform(final_train.iloc[:, :2]),
        final_train["text_cleaned"].values[:, None],
        final_train["token_count"].values[:, None],
        final_train["word_freq"].values[:, None],
        final_train["tone_score"].values[:, None],
    ]
)

X_train_processed = X_train_processed.astype(np.float32)
X_train_processed[:, :2] = scaler.transform(X_train_processed[:, :2])

X_val_processed = np.column_stack(
    [
        scaler.transform(final_val.iloc[:, :2]),
        final_val["text_cleaned"].values[:, None],
        final_val["token_count"].values[:, None],
        final_val["word_freq"].values[:, None],
        final_val["tone_score"].values[:, None],
    ]
)
X_val_processed = X_val_processed.astype(np.float32)
X_val_processed[:, :2] = scaler.transform(X_val_processed[:, :2])

# Train LightGBM model
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=10,
    num_leaves=64,
    random_state=42,

)

test_X["text_cleaned"] = test_X["text_cleaned"].apply(

test_token_list = []

test_tone_list = []
for txt in test_X["text_cleaned"].astype(str):
    tokens = [w for w in txt.split() if len(w) > 2]

    pos_words = [
        "thank",

        "yes",

        "kind",

    ]
    neg_words = ["edit", "removed", "closed", "failed", "unsuccessful", "sorry"]
    pos = sum(1 for w in pos_words if w in txt.lower())
    neg = sum(1 for w in neg_words if w in txt.lower())
    test_token_list.append(len(tokens))
    test_word_list.append(word_list)
    test_tone_list.append(pos - neg)

test_X = test_X.rename(columns={"text_cleaned": "text_cleaned"})
test_X["token_count"] = test_token_list
test_X["word_freq"] = test_word_list
test_X["tone_score"] = test_tone_list

# Scale test features
X_test = np.column_stack(

X_test = X_test.astype(np.float32)
X_test[:, :2] = scaler.transform(X_test[:, :2])

test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

test_df_out = pd.DataFrame(
